entities.summary: Hàm Long Church, officially Church of St. Anthony of Padua, is a Roman Catholic church in the center district Hoàn Kiếm of Hanoi, Vietnam. The church was built at the end of the 19th century near an old street named Hàm Long from which Hàm Long Church was called. Today, Hàm Long Church is one of the three major churches of Hanoi, together with Cửa Bắc Church and Saint Joseph Cathedral. It was named after saint Anthony of Padua.
